name: Fire Scar Shrine
summary: At Fire Scar Shrine, fel corruption has seized the old night elf place of worship southwest of Astranaar. Demons now gather among its altar stones.

sections.title: A Blight in the Forest
sections.body: Southwest of Astranaar and west of the Ruins of Stardust, Fire Scar Shrine lies beneath a spreading blight. Servants of the Cult of the Dark Strand and the Shadow Council feed its corruption. Fel magic has scorched the earth, and demons gather openly among the trees. The forest's defenders face them there.

sections.title: Shadows of the Dark Strand
sections.body: Ilkrud Magthrull, an orc warlock, brought corruption to Fire Scar Shrine under Athrikus Narassin's orders. He served the Cult of the Dark Strand, alongside agents of the Shadow Council. Summoned fiends now patrol the altar stones unchecked. A tear in the veil sometimes draws greater horrors, including the towering doomguard Akkrilus.

faq.q: Where is Fire Scar Shrine located?
faq.answer: Fire Scar Shrine lies in southwestern Ashenvale, southwest of Astranaar, south of the Shrine of Aessina, and west of the Ruins of Stardust.

faq.q: Why are there demons at Fire Scar Shrine?
faq.answer: Agents of the Shadow Council and the Cult of the Dark Strand corrupted Fire Scar Shrine. The orc warlock Ilkrud Magthrull was among them. Their rituals summoned demons and left fel taint on the sacred ground.
Akkrilus is a doomguard sometimes drawn to Fire Scar Shrine by the demonic energies around its corrupted stones.

faq.q: What connection does this place have to the Cult of the Dark Strand?
aliases: cult of the dark strand fire scar
faq.answer: Ilkrud Magthrull, the orc warlock at Fire Scar Shrine, served Athrikus Narassin, leader of the Cult of the Dark Strand. They used the shrine as a foothold for demonic summoning and their ambitions in Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a night elf, you have cause to seek swift retribution for the demons desecrating Fire Scar Shrine so near Astranaar.
As a warlock, you can read the Shadow Council's mark in Fire Scar Shrine's fel scars and wild demonic summons. They point to the Council's infiltrations across Kalimdor.
